function.name: read_file
function.description: Open a file from the team workspace and show its content.

path.description: The workspace path of the file

function.name: share_file
function.description: Share a workspace file with a person.

path.description: The workspace path of the file

recipient.description: The email address of the person to share with

access.description: What the person may do with the file

function.name: move_file
function.description: Move a workspace file into another folder.

path.description: The workspace path of the file to move

destination.description: The folder to move the file into

function.name: rename_file
function.description: Rename a workspace file (it stays in its folder).

path.description: The workspace path of the file to rename

new_name.description: The new file name, with its extension

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search the workspace for files about a topic.
